summary: Design is broken down by the kind of artifact whose definition is authored: mechanical geometry (solid and surface modeling, geometry exchange, product definition and tolerancing, product data management), the built environment (buildings, civil sites, plant and building services, electrical wiring), electronics (boards, circuit simulation, digital logic, digital IC implementation, custom IC design, IC signoff), quantity takeoff and estimating, and craft patterns. The mechanical split follows ISO 10303 application protocols (AP203/214/242) and the CIMdata MCAD and cPDm segments; the AEC split follows buildingSMART IFC domains, OmniClass and MasterFormat; the electronics split follows the ACM CCS 2012 Hardware subtree (EDA, functional verification, hardware test, printed circuit boards) and the ESD Alliance categories (CAE, IC physical design and verification, PCB and MCM). The IC and board leaves are drawn at the grain of the ISPD, ICCAD, TAU and IWLS contests and the VerilogEval-style LLM benchmarks, so that most have a public benchmark already.

capabilities.name: Mechanical solid and surface modeling
capabilities.definition: Given design intent as requirements, sketches or reference geometry, produce exact boundary-representation or implicit models of parts, tooling and assemblies.

crosswalk.label: Mechanical computer-aided design (MCAD)
Managed model-based 3D engineering
Configuration Controlled Design
Applied computing > Physical sciences and engineering > Engineering > Computer-aided design
Computing methodologies > Computer graphics > Shape modeling

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Solid and surface modeling'. Kept as one capability because sketch solving, features, kernel operations, assemblies and surfacing are layers of one modeling stack. Geometry exchange and repair split into its own capability because translation and healing are separately benchmarked (CAx-IF) and serve every CAD system. Topology optimization and generative design are left to simulate because they are driven by a physics solve. Organic and entertainment 3D modeling stays in media.

tasks.name: Constrained sketch solving
tasks.definition: Given 2D sketch entities with geometric and dimensional constraints, compute a consistent solution and report remaining degrees of freedom or conflicts.
tasks.inputs: points, lines, arcs, splines; coincidence, tangency, parallel, distance, angle and other constraints
tasks.outputs: solved entity positions; degrees-of-freedom status; over- or under-constrained diagnosis
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: the SketchGraphs dataset gives millions of real constraint graphs whose solutions can be checked exactly
tasks.notes: The commercial solvers are licensed components embedded in most mechanical CAD systems.

tasks.name: Feature-based parametric part modeling
tasks.definition: Given design intent and dimensions, build a history of sketches and features (extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, hole, pattern, fillet) that evaluates to a valid solid.
tasks.inputs: requirements, dimensions, reference geometry, material
tasks.outputs: editable feature tree and the boundary-representation solid it evaluates to

crosswalk.label: Construction history and parametric features (AP242 edition 2)

tasks.benchmarkable: yes: target solids from the DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery reconstruction datasets allow geometric comparison (volume overlap, surface distance) of a rebuilt part
tasks.notes: Code-based modelers (CadQuery, build123d, OpenSCAD) make the feature history a program, which is what most open benchmarks score.

tasks.name: Model generation from text, images or drawings
tasks.definition: Given a natural-language description, image, sketch or 2D engineering drawing of a part, produce an editable parametric model that matches it.
tasks.inputs: text description, photograph or render, hand sketch, or multi-view dimensioned drawing
tasks.outputs: parametric part model or modeling program; deviation from the specified geometry
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: Text2CAD, DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery provide paired inputs and ground-truth models; drawing-to-model can be scored by rebuilding the drawing views
tasks.notes: Distinct from parametric part modeling by its input: the task is interpreting an informal or 2D specification, which is where the project's brep-bench sits. No O*NET product does this.

tasks.name: Boundary representation modeling operations
tasks.definition: Given one or more boundary-representation solids and an operation, compute the resulting valid solid for Booleans, fillets and chamfers, shelling, offsets and drafts.
tasks.inputs: B-rep solids; operation type and parameters; tolerances
tasks.outputs: valid closed B-rep solid, or a located failure

crosswalk.label: Computing methodologies > Computer graphics > Shape modeling > Parametric curve and surface models

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: validity and success rate of operations on ABC dataset models are measurable, but no standard kernel robustness suite exists
tasks.notes: This is the geometric kernel layer that every modeler above relies on. Manifold works on meshes, not exact B-rep.

tasks.name: Assembly modeling with mating constraints

capabilities.definition: Given a style and fit or form requirements, author the patterns, models or stitch programs from which garments, jewelry, textiles and craft goods are made.

crosswalk.label: Size designation of clothes: anthropometric definitions for body measurement

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Apparel, pattern, jewelry and other craft design'. Marker making (nesting pattern pieces on fabric) is left to produce with other nesting. Orthotic, prosthetic, dental and eyeglass design are handed to health. Sign design is media.

tasks.name: Garment pattern drafting
tasks.definition: Given body measurements and a style, draft the flat pattern pieces of a garment with seam allowances, notches and grain lines.
tasks.inputs: body measurements or size chart; style description or sketch; fabric properties
tasks.outputs: pattern pieces with annotations; tech pack data
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: measurement-driven drafts can be checked against drafting systems, and sewing-pattern datasets such as GarmentCode exist; fit and style are judged

tasks.name: Pattern grading
tasks.definition: Given a base-size pattern, a size chart and grade rules, generate the pattern in every size.
tasks.inputs: base pattern; size chart; grade rules
tasks.outputs: graded nest of sizes
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: rule-based grading is deterministic

tasks.name: Virtual garment fitting
tasks.definition: Given pattern pieces, an avatar and fabric properties, sew and drape the garment virtually to evaluate fit and appearance before sampling.
tasks.inputs: pattern pieces and sewing instructions; avatar; fabric mechanical properties
tasks.outputs: draped garment; strain and pressure fit maps; renders
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: drape can be compared with physical drape tests; fit judgment is human
tasks.notes: Kept in design because it is part of the pattern loop; the cloth solver is physics.

tasks.name: Jewelry and gemstone design
tasks.definition: Given a design concept and stones, model rings, settings and stone layouts for casting or printing, or design gemstone facet diagrams.
tasks.inputs: concept; finger or chain sizes; stone sizes and shapes; metal; for gems, rough dimensions and refractive index
tasks.outputs: printable or castable jewelry model with metal weight; facet diagram and cutting instructions
onet_products: Computer assisted jewelry design CAD software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: metal weight, stone fit and facet light return are computable; design is judged

tasks.name: Embroidery and quilt design
tasks.definition: Given artwork or a block layout, produce machine stitch programs or quilt layouts with yardage.
tasks.inputs: artwork; fabric and thread; stitch types; or quilt block and layout choices
tasks.outputs: machine embroidery stitch file; quilt layout and fabric yardage
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: stitch count, density and yardage are measurable; visual fidelity needs judgment

tasks.name: Textile print repeat design
tasks.definition: Given motifs and a repeat type, compose a seamless repeating print and its colorways for textile printing.
tasks.inputs: motifs; repeat type and size; color palette
tasks.outputs: seamless repeat tile; colorway separations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: seamlessness and color count are checkable; aesthetics are not

tasks.name: Cabinet and millwork design
tasks.definition: Given a room layout and a construction standard, design cabinets and millwork and generate parts lists and cut lists.
tasks.inputs: room layout; cabinet construction standards; materials and hardware
tasks.outputs: cabinet models; parts and cut lists; shop drawings
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: part dimensions follow from construction rules and are checkable
tasks.notes: Panel nesting and CNC output are produce.

existing_function_map.note: Mechanical and surface modelers go to solid_modeling; generic and 2D CAD to product_definition (drafting); 'reverse engineering', IGES and Geomagic patterns to geometry_exchange; the 3D plant layout patterns (PDMS, SmartMarine, AutoPLANT, CADWorx) to plant_services.
Board design patterns to pcb; the board-level SPICE patterns (PSpice, LTspice, Multisim, ngspice) to circuit_simulation, which also serves IC design.

Split five ways. The device and process TCAD patterns (SUPREM, PISCES, Medici, FLOOPS, FLOODS, etch simulation) are handed to simulate; MEMS layout stays in custom_ic and lithography correction in ic_signoff.

Design half only: BIM and architecture, road and site design, structural detailing (Tekla). The structural analysis patterns (STAAD, RISA, STRUDL, ENERCALC) and geotechnical patterns (gINT, GeoStudio) go to simulate.

open_questions: This domain has 16 capabilities, above the 6 to 14 guidance, because the electronics sources (ACM CCS, ESD Alliance) and the contest benchmarks split IC work finely. If the editor wants 14, merge design.custom_ic with design.ic_signoff, and design.electrical_systems back into design.plant_services as the seed had it.

Semiconductor process and device simulation (TCAD) was in the existing 'ic' function but is physics; I handed it to simulate, whose seeds do not name it. Simulate should add it or the editor should return it here.
Lens and optical system design (Zemax, OSLO) is authoring a prescription but is done by ray-trace optimization; I handed it to simulate, which lists optics. Confirm.
Hardware description languages are placed in design, not computing's programming languages. Computing's author may have claimed Verilog and VHDL from the shared Development environment category.
Requirements management for hardware systems (DOORS) is left to computing; if the editor prefers a systems-engineering node near PLM, design.product_data is the natural parent.
Tolerance stack-up analysis and virtual garment fitting are analyses kept in design because they sit inside the design loop and are not general physics; simulate may disagree about the cloth solver.
see_also ids pointing into other domains are guesses at their likely node ids and need reconciling once all domain files exist.
